scope: Document the existing external-inventory ingestion boundary without changing production inventory semantics.

field_capabilities.external_audit_rule: Accept only when source identity and mapping provenance are explicit.
May be preserved only as adapter-side provenance until a deliberate inventory contract change is authorized.
Do not discard it silently; retain it in source provenance and reject claims that require operator identity.
Require declared CRS and conversion evidence before mapping.
Keep source azimuth distinct from a planned orientation unless the reference frame is documented.
Require measured or documented height provenance; never substitute the planning default.
Accept only with explicit source semantics.
Accept only with explicit source semantics.
Only accept when conducted-output semantics are established.
Convert only when antenna gain, feeder/system losses, and EIRP reference are all explicit; otherwise reject absolute-power claims.
Do not map a relative pattern peak or an undocumented gain value into absolute gain.
Arbitrary radiation files and undocumented pattern reconstruction are unsupported.
Require unit, carrier direction, and frequency/ARFCN reconciliation.
Require declared occupied or configured bandwidth semantics; do not infer from a channel number.
Preserve raw channel and mapped frequency together; reject unresolved unit/epoch mismatches.
Require explicit technology; do not infer 4G/5G from frequency alone.
PCI is not a globally unique transmitter identity; retain the separate serving-cell mapping.
Do not claim explicit neighbor truth from a tower list, channel, or PCI alone.
A source without resource allocation, load, and noise/interference provenance cannot support SINR/RSRQ/RSSI or radio-quality validation.

defaulting_behavior.normal_planning: The UI and profile resolver fill omitted profile values from plan and technology defaults.
defaulting_behavior.external_benchmark_audit: Forbidden. Every benchmark field that affects the declared claim must be direct, recoverable with documented semantics, or explicitly unavailable.
material_defaults: 2.6 GHz LTE Band 7 and 20 MHz bandwidth
28 GHz NR n257 and 100 MHz bandwidth
defaulting_behavior.policy: Do not use these planning defaults to reconstruct an external transmitter or receiver.

conversion_rules.rule: P_tx_conducted = EIRP - G_tx_absolute only when the source EIRP reference plane, antenna gain, feeder loss, and polarization convention are explicit.
A relative plot is not an absolute gain or a supported built-in pattern unless its parameterization is explicitly documented and equivalent.
Require origin, projection, axis direction, units, and conversion test points.
Apply the declared band-specific mapping only after validating duplex direction, raster, and source epoch; retain the raw value.

can_ingest_without_production_change: conducted power and absolute gain when semantics are explicit
supported built-in patterns when equivalence is demonstrated
receiver-side quantities as observations with provenance
cannot_claim_without_contract_change_or_: absolute received-power truth from EIRP-only data
receiver calibration or antenna correction that is not in the source record
